end.summary: Prisha discussed energy as something that makes things move or heat up.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of energy making a pan heat up and leaves or a kite move. Prisha asked for pictures or drawings several times, and used the idea that wind pushes leaves to explain their movement. They still mixed up whether air can have energy and did not complete the teach-back; Asha did not get a later confirmed correction in the lesson. At home, ask Prisha to name what changes when a stove heats a pan, wind moves leaves, or sunlight helps plants grow.
